title: CoverStory Days 113–126 manual recovery of retained local delivery work
outcome: Operator can inspect, reversibly quarantine, release, and explicitly recover one retained synthetic work identity without duplicating its local receipt effect or hiding a batch failure.
constraints: Keep V004 and source events/receipts immutable; add V005 controls only.
No broker, scheduler, lease, automatic retry, new HTTP route, UI feature, cloud resource, credentials, or real customer data.
Receipt and acknowledgement remain separate transactions.
Shared work-row lock; receipt evidence is read in a fresh statement after waiting.
Capture excludes neither acknowledged nor quarantined source keys from anti-join; no replacement identity.
Recovery days 119 and 126 are prior-only review/remediation.
No learner completion inferred from dates, scaffold, or temporary witnesses.
